title: QuickBooks Online pricing - $20-$275/month across five tiers, plus mandatory payroll add-ons
clean_text: QuickBooks Online's 2026 tiers are Solopreneur ($20/month), Simple Start ($38/month, 1 user), Essentials ($75/month, 3 users), Plus ($115/month, up to 25 users), and Advanced ($275/month, 25 users plus extra features). All plans currently offer 50% off for the first three months before reverting to full price. Payroll add-ons (mandatory for businesses with employees) cost $50/month plus $6.50/employee, pushing real costs well above the listed price for most businesses. Intuit raised prices roughly 15-20% in July 2025, and QuickBooks Desktop Pro Plus/Mac Plus annual pricing rises from $999 to $1,149 (single-user) starting February 1, 2026.
